# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Run accessibility analysis (open analyze features dialog)
3. Launch the Data Sync Toolbar and ensure a "Data Sync Session" is created.
4. Open the _Data Sync_ _Session_ _Viewer_ and select `Show only dirty records`
5. Navigate to, and click on, each feature (that has an `AccessibilityProperties_` with an empty string).
6. Repeat for all `AccessibilityProperties_` that are empty. (i.e. `door`, `window`, `stairs`, etc)
7. Using the _Data Sync_ _Session_ _Viewer_ "_Compare_" button, for each of the selected features, note down the Feature class, and Object ID numbers
    - You will compare the _AccessibilityProperties_ from the Local database to the Remote database. You will use this information in the next step
8. Execute the following SQL scripts against the Local database to retrieve the following values for
